name: Shin-Koiwa
tagline: Tokyo in 16 minutes and Otemachi in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Katsushika City, where JR East run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 36 minutes to Shinjuku, 40 minutes to Shibuya and 30 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 2.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 3.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -1.3 m to 2.5 m, a difference of 3.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 9 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: エネルギースーパーたじま

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 佐久間病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 道園会東京松永病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) run through it. JR Sobu Main Line also call here. Both lines are run by JR East, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: JR Sobu Main Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 新小岩→錦糸町, which includes this station. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1K ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Shin-Koiwa is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: About 2 km away in a straight line. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shin-Koiwa.

neighbours.lead: Keisei-Tateishi is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Shin-Koiwa is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 2.5 km away in a straight line. It takes 12 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shin-Koiwa.

People living alone who want to hold the rent down

noiseSources: 平和橋通り (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively many of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
